goal: Enable a fully autonomous WhatsApp brand representative that resolves customer needs, uses live business tools, searches external knowledge, understands diverse media and initiates eligible follow-ups with minimal owner intervention
proposal: Build a capability-first Bun agent orchestrator with brand knowledge, hybrid retrieval, multimodal processing, a dynamic business tool registry, durable workflows and proactive engagement; selectively extract Python and Go workers

evidence.finding: Existing repository already has Bun, Gemini, Baileys transport, conversation memory and an RTL/LTR interface
Hierarchical context folding with message lineage is planned, so new Customer 360 should integrate instead of duplicate it
Gemini supports app-executed custom function calls for chained external tool use
Grounded search can provide recent externally sourced facts
Docling provides structured parsing across several document and media formats
WhatsApp Business Platform supports automated replies and proactive business templates within consent and messaging rules

evidence.source: Architecture evaluation of existing Bun app and Python document processing needs
evidence.finding: Capability modules can be integrated early without immediately requiring independent Go and Rust services

direct_check.source: Repository structure and documented context-fold plan
direct_check.finding: The current code can host agent planning and typed tool calls, while long-term folding is proposed and must not be counted as implemented

assumptions.claim: Owners want Auto-Pilot as the default interaction model
assumptions.basis: Explicit owner product correction in this conversation

assumptions.claim: The first revenue segment will be retail brands
assumptions.basis: Illustrative use cases; actual merchant cohort must decide connector priority

assumptions.claim: Hybrid FTS5 plus embeddings can handle initial brand corpora
assumptions.basis: Quality and latency require benchmark on realistic Arabic/English catalog queries

assumptions.claim: A separate Go scheduled-task service will outperform Bun for target load
assumptions.basis: No scheduling or restart load benchmark exists

decision_axes.selected: autonomous agent operating within brand-configured scope

alternatives.name: Approval-led moderation dashboard
alternatives.risk: Fails the owner's fully autonomous brand management goal
alternatives.reversal: Retain only as optional Co-Pilot mode

alternatives.name: Bun core with typed tools and Python media worker
alternatives.benefit: Direct use of existing app state, rapid integrated agent capabilities and isolated parsing
alternatives.risk: Requires deliberate workflow journal and testing across tool failures
alternatives.reversal: Disable a skill or connector and fall back to chat behavior

alternatives.name: Immediate polyglot independent services
alternatives.risk: Adds operational boundaries and coordination before customer value is demonstrated
alternatives.reversal: Collapse boundaries back into Bun modules

horizons.scenario: Single brand pilot with product or service data and one live connector
horizons.consequence: Deliver Brand Brain, hybrid RAG, planner and a complete tool-backed customer goal

horizons.scenario: Several brands with high attachment throughput and frequent proactive scheduled actions
horizons.consequence: Measure Python worker concurrency, retrieval store needs, official Cloud API adapter coverage and conditional Go scheduling

decision.choice: Default Auto-Pilot with a Bun-owned conversation planner, brand knowledge, evidence retrieval, live connectors, multimodal worker and autonomous eligible follow-ups; keep policy checks automatic and supporting
decision.reason: The customer value is independently completing business conversations, not accumulating moderation controls. Existing app components and official APIs permit a capability-first extension.
decision.invalidated_by: Direct evidence that target merchants require a different product mode, a failed tool accuracy benchmark, missing WhatsApp provider support for intended workflows or non-viable data isolation
